thread:
sam: quick poll  Create Integration form UX: inline live errors or top summary on submit? also what's our required-field pattern (asterisk vs explicit 'Required')? and pattern for 'Delete all integrations' confirmation: checkbox vs typed confirm?

 rita: inline live for short forms (2-4 fields). users get immediate feedback. for longer forms do inline + top summary on submit.

 noah: agree. required marker: explicit 'Required' is clearer, show asterisk too as shorthand and include legend in header if we use asterisks site-wide.

 ella (a11y): accessibility: always set aria-required on inputs. don't rely on color/asterisk alone; include visible text or a visually-hidden label for screen readers. inline errors should use aria-live so they're announced. when submit fails, focus the summary with a link to first invalid field.

 rita: for bulk delete typed confirm is safest for "Delete all". for single-item delete, checkbox + confirm button is fine. copy: "Type DELETE to confirm permanent removal." keep it explicit.

 noah: maybe threshold rule: typed confirm for >10 items or when user selects "All". show count and sample items in modal.

 sam: agreed. action items: 1) spec two validation modes: inline-only for compact forms, hybrid for long forms; 2) required: visible 'Required' + asterisk shorthand; implement aria-required; 3) destructive: checkbox for small deletes, typed confirm for "All" or large sets with count + irreversible copy; 4) a11y checklist: aria-live, focus summary, focus trap in modal. i'll update figma and PR copy. @rita @ella please quick thumbs. :thumbsup:
